tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rje stag lung thang pa'i zhal gdams tshogs chos su gsungs pa'o/ /

na mo rat+na gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po chos kyi sku rtogs pa'am thob par byed pa la rgyu rnam pa gsum tshang dgos/ de gang la zer na bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa dang/ sems can la dmigs nas byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems sgom pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i bla ma dam pa la mos gus byed pa dang gsum ya ma bral ba zhig dgos/ de yang dang por tshogs ma bsags na mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma mi rnyed la/ chos byed pa'i blo mi skye/ bla ma rnyed pa zhig tu gyur kyang mos gus mi skye/ skyon gyi sgo nas rtog pas rang la yon tan mi skye/ dper na/ bsod nams ma bsags kyi skyes bu de/ chos byed pa tsug 'dug kyang thur du ltung*/ gsungs pas/ tshogs gsog pa 'di dang por gal che/ de ltar tshogs gsog pa zhig yin yang rang don du byas pas mi yong ste/ byams pa dang snying rjes kun nas bslang ba'i rang las ma 'khris par gzhan don 'ba' zhig tu byed pa zhig dgos/ chos de gnyis dang ldan yang bla ma la mos gus byed ma shes na 'khor ba'i rtsa ba mi chod cing chos sku mi thob pas/ des na bla ma la mos gus byed pa gal che/ lam zab mo bla ma'i mos gus yin/ lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba yang bla ma la mos gus byas pa tshang ste/ bla ma'i sku dge 'dun dkon mchog /gsung chos dkon mchog /thugs sangs rgyas dkon mchog yin pas/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo yang bla ma yin/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed nas sems can thams cad kyi don du mos pa dang gus pa byas nas/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo yang de la tshang*/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la chos sku 'ba' zhig gis 'du shes skyes sam/ yang chos skur mos pa bskyed nas dad gus byas na don dam byang chub sems yang der 'dus pa yin/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yin ang snyam du bsams nas/

mos gus byas na mchog gi skyabs 'gro yang de la tshang*/ de skad du yang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba de/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa/ dkon mchog gsum yang bla ma yin la/ khyad par du yang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo dpal rdo rje rang yin/ des na bla ma'i sku la mos gus mchog tu gyur pa byas na bum dbang thob par 'gro ba yin/ gsung la mos gus byas na dbang gnyis pa gsang dbang thob par 'gro ba yin/ thugs la mos gus byas na dbang gsum pa shes rab yai shes thob pa yin/ sku gsung thugs ca ge ba la mos pa dang gus pa chen po byas na rang sems stong nyid 'od gsal rtogs/ des dbang bzhi pa rdzogs pa yin/ dkyil 'khor bris nas dbang bskur byed pa ni cho ga yan lag tshang ba tsam ste rgyud smin pa dka'/ rgyud smin par bya ba ni rang sems chos sku mngon du gyur pa la zer ba yin te/ de ni dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'dzoms pa la yong ba yin/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha la/ slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mos gus mthar thug pa byas pas skad cig gis dngos grub mthar thug pa thob pas na/ de skad du yang*/ mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub de/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la/ /mos gus byas na 'du ba yin/ /zhes pas yon tan thams cad skye bar byed pa ni bla ma la mos gus byas pa las 'byung ba yin/ tshogs rnam pa gnyis yang mos gus la tshang ste/ yod pa rnams kyis rdzas dang yo byad 'bul ba dang*/ lus kyi sgo nas zhabs tog byed pa dang*/ med pas kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing snying thag pa nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ bsod nams kyi tshogs yin la/ mos gus byas pa'i stobs kyis rang sems skye med du go bas bla ma bka' drin can du go ba'am/ bla ma la chos skur go ba ni ye shes kyi tshogs yin/

sdom pa gsum yang mos gus byas pa la tshang ste/ bla mas slob la mi dge ba la mi sbyor te/ dkar po dge ba 'ba' zhig la 'god/ de skad du'ang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /ces pa dang*/ gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog tu 'jug /dge ba bcu nyams su len du 'jug pa'o/ /de yang mos gus rab ci gsung gi bka' las mi 'da' ba yin pas/ bla mas ci skad gsungs pa nyams su len pa ni so so thar pa'i sdom par 'ong ba yin/ ci gsung gi bka' las mi 'da' sems can gyi don du mos gus byed pa de byang chub sems pa'i sdom par 'ong ba yin/ ci gsung gi bka' las mi 'da' bar rang gi sems sgom zhing spyod lam bzhi dang sbyar nas sgrub pa nyams su len pa de rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom par 'ong ba yin/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang du len pa yang mos gus byas pa la tshang ste/ ser sna spangs pa'i tshul khrims kyi rdzas dang yo byad 'bul ba ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ de ltar rdzas dang ka ca 'bul ba dang zhabs tog byed pa ni shī la'o/ /zhabs tog byed pa ni sdug bsngal khyad du bsad nas dka' las bzod par byed pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ de la g.yol ba med par brtson pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ de dag gi ngo bo la sems rtse gcig pas rgyun ma chad par byed pas bsam gtan gyi pha rol phyin pa yin/ de dag thams cad la rlom sems med cing rang bzhin med par shes pa de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ des na bla ma la mos gus byas pa las yon tan thams cad 'du ba yin pas/ byang chub ma thob bar du nyin mo spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom/ mtshan mo snying gi dkyil du bsgom/ sangs rgyas nas kyang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par 'ong ba yin/ rang sems rgyal ba chos sku la/ /bla ma btsal du ma mchis kyang*/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bla ma de/

/'ja' tshon bzhin du spyi bos bkur/ /de'i gnad ka yang bla ma dang rdo rje 'chang tha dad med pa yin/ de dgos pa gar gal che na nam yang mi sdod 'gro /cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba yin pas/ /de bzhin thugs la gdags par zhu/ /rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi rtsa ba thams cad rang gi sems yin pas rang sems go dgos/ rtogs dgos/ ji ltar rtogs dgos na skye ba med par rtogs dgos/ rang bzhin med par rtogs dgos/ stong pa nyid du rtogs dgos/ lhun grub tu rtogs dgos/ skye med ji ltar rtogs dgos na/ rtsa ba shes rab las/ skye ba med pa 'gag pa med/ /ces pa la sogs pa dang*/ sdud pa las kyang*/ skye ba med dang skye ba gnyis kar mi rtog pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /zhes pas rang sems skye med du rtogs dgos// //na mo rat+na gu ru/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'khor 'das thams cad rang gi sems su 'dus/ sems byas pas kyang logs shig na yod pa lta bu ma yin/ rang la yod pa'i rig rig tur tur po 'di nyid yin/ 'di ma go ma rig ma rtogs nas 'khor ba zhes bya/ go ba dang rig pa dang rtogs par gyur na mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya/ de yang sdug bsngal thams cad la mya ngan zhes ming btags/ ngar 'dzin la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las grol ba'am 'das pas na/ mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya/ da lta dang 'o skol gyi rgyud la 'gro ba rigs drug gi cha mthun tshang ba yin/ de gang zhe na lus la na ba dang tsha ba dang grang ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal drag po yod pa'i dus na dmyal ba dang cha mthun yin/ bkres pa dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal drag po nyams su myong ba'i dus na ni yi dwags dang cha mthun/ bying ba dang rmugs pa dang glen zhing gti mug pa'i dus na dud 'gro /tshe 'di phyi la sogs pa rnam gzhag shes pa'i cha nas mi/ zhe sdang drag po skyes pa dang gzhan la brdeg pa la tshegs med pa'i cha nas lha ma yin/

gzugs bzang ba dang longs spyod che ba dang rgyud la zhi gnas mthug po yod pa dang tshe ring ba la sogs pa yod pa'i cha nas lha dang cha mthun pa yin/ bde sdug btang snyoms nyams su ci myong yang rang gi sems las ma gtogs pa gzhan med/ sems rang de ltar snang ba yin/ 'khor ba las 'da' bar byed pa la tshe 'di'i rnam gzhag thams cad spangs nas chos byed dgos/ tshe 'di dang phyi ma thams cad du rang gzhan gnyis ka la phan pa chos yin pas/ chos zer nas kyang logs na gzhan med/ rang gi rig pa 'di byams snying rje ci skye/ spros pa med pa'i ngang la ci 'gro /'gro la phan ci thogs kyi blo gros 'ba' zhig yin/ btsun pa zer nas bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba rnag phug la thug pa las kyang 'dzem yang*/ 'chi khar zhe sdang skad cig ma gcig skyes na dmyal ba'i kha mi khegs te/ dge slong kha leb dang sran chen lta bu yin te/ kha leb dang sran chen/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi ring la bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba la skra'i rtse mo tsam zhig ma gos kyang*/ dgra bcom pa zhig la 'chi khar zhe sdang skyes pas mnar med du song ba lta bu dang*/ 'chi khar chos gos la chags pas glegs bu'i bar du sbrul du skyes pa dang*/ lhung bzed la chags pas lhung bzed kyi nang du sbrul du skyes pa la sogs 'dul ba nyid nas dpag tu med pa gsungs/ btsun pa 'di shin tu gal che 'di med na thar pa sgrub tu mi btub pa yin/ tshul khrims dang dam tshig la nan tan byed cing rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod pa kho na gal che/ 'on kyang tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la btsun pa gcig pus kyang bag mi 'ong*/ sems stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can dang ma bral ba gal che/ de skad du yang spyod 'jug las/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ /sems gzhan yengs pas byas pa ni/ /de ni thub pas don med gsungs/ /zhes pa dang*/ gal te mnyam bzhag sems brtan na/ /lus ngag dge ba gtsor mi bya/

/zhes pa dang*/ sems srung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa/ /brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'dul ba las kyang man ngag yod na bsam gtan bya/ /med na rab tu 'bad de bklag /ces pa dang*/ rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /zhes pa la sogs pa gsungs/ 'on kyang thub pas gsungs pa'i sdom pa gsum dang bslab pa gsum dang*/ khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dam tshig dang 'gal na/ tshul khrims lci yang bstan pa'i mdo nas ngan song du 'gro bar gsungs pas/ sems can gyi don byed pa la nyes ltung phra ba'i phra ba la 'dzem dgos/ nyes ltung phra ba'i phra ba bshags dgos/ lar lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa zhig yod na ci byas sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gro / sems spros pa mtha' dang bral bar go na chos sku nam mkha' lta bu dang zhal mjal/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi ting nge 'dzin zhig yod na/ snang ba bde chen du 'char/ dngos rnams bla mar gyur/ rigs drug gi bag chags zad/ 'gro drug gi g.yang sa khegs/ las ngan gyi lcags sgrog grol/ nyon mongs kyi zhags pa chod/ dgra gnyen gnyis med/ 'khor 'das gnyis med/ re dogs gnyis med/ spang blang gnyis med/ de lta bu 'ong ba'am thob par byed pa la/ tshogs gsog pa dang bla ma la mos gus byed pa dang*/ sdom pas bsdams pa'i bsrung bya la nan chags byed pa shin tu gal che/ sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la nyon mongs pa zhi dgos/ sde snod rin chen gsum po yang nyon mongs 'dul ba'i gnyen por gsungs/ rgyud sde rin chen bzhi po yang*/ /nyams rtogs bskyed pa'i thabs su gsungs/ /byin rlabs can gyi bla ma la/ /mos gus tshul bzhin byas gyur na/ /rtogs pa mchog tu gyur par nges/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa la/ /tshul khrims rnam dag shin tu gces/ /rgyu 'bras mkha' ltar rtogs gyur yang*/ /nyes byas phra mo kun la 'dzems/ /gsungs/

lar skyes bu kun spros pa chod la 'bod la bsgoms dang rang sems skye med du rtogs nas 'ong gis/ stong nyid gtan la 'bab pa'i tshig dang tha snyad mang po bslabs pas mi phan/ ci nas kyang bsgom dgos/ da res dal 'byor gyi lus 'di la brten nas 'khor ba dang 'brel thag gcod dgos/ rang sems la sgro 'dogs ma chod na cis kyang mi phan/ brtse sems che ba'i grogs pos kyang mi phan/ 'jig rten na dbang che ba dang phyug pa dang bsod nams che bas kyang mi phan/ rang gis go ma bcad na bla ma rang gis kyang stongs par dka'/ ma lags ma yag na rak+sha glang mgo can gyi snang ba 'char dogs yod pas tshogs gsog pa dang bla ma la mos gus byed pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang dam tshig ma nyams par bsrung ba dang*/ bya brel spangs nas sgom pa la brtson 'grus gyis/ tshe la long med pas 'chi ba'i dus su sems la 'gyod pa med pa zhig dgos/ sems nyid shin tu gsal ba dang chos nyid shin tu gsal bar 'grogs nas bar dor sangs rgyas dgos pas/ de bzhin du thugs la btags par zhu/ /a+thi+-i// //༄༅/ /na mo rat+na gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du ma shes na/ chos gsha' mar byed pa'i blo skye ba dka'/ chos 'di byed blo bltas los mi 'ongs pas snying thag pa nas sgrub pa tshul bzhin du nyams su len dgos/ rang sems las su ma rung na/ /gnas gang du bsdad kyang btson khang la/ /grogs su dang 'grogs kyang btson rdzi yin/ /rdzas dang yo byad thams cad kyang 'ching bar byed pa'i rgya dang mtshungs/ des na tshe 'di'i rtod thag bcad la/ brtson 'grus chen pos lam nyams su blangs pa la 'bad dgos/ rang gi sems 'di go dgos/ rtogs dgos/ zhi dgos/ grol dgos/ de ltar 'ong ba la bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig bsten dgos/ bla ma'i mtshan nyid chos thams cad nas mang du gsungs kyang*/ 'o skol gyi chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/

tshe 'di la ltos pa skra'i rtse mo tsam yang med pa zhig dgos/ snying rje chen po 'gro ba gzhan gyi sdug bsngal mi bzod pa zhig dgos/ shes rab chen pos 'gro ba gzhan gyi lam sna 'dren nus pa zhig dgos gsungs/ tshe 'di'i mchan tshe 'di blos ma spangs pa'i bshes gnyen gyis rang gzhan gnyis ka 'jig rten 'di la sbyor bas tshe 'di'i ltos pa chod pa zhig dgos/ ltos pa dang bral ba zhig yin yang*/ snying rje chen po zhig rgyud la med na gzhan sdug bsngal gyi nyen pa'i skyabs mgon mi 'ongs pas/ snying rje dang stong pa dbyer med pa'i sgo nas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel nus pa zhig dgos/ de gnyis dang ldan yang shes rab chen po zhig med na/ ma grol pas ni grol mi nus/ /long bas lam ston ga la nus/ /mnyam nyid 'dam du tshud pa na/ /gcig gis gcig 'don par mi nus/ /des na snang ba med pa'i shes rab kyi zag pa med pa'i mngon shes kyi sgo nas 'gro ba gzhan gyis lam sna 'dren nus pa zhig dgos/ de lta bu'i bla ma shin tu dka' bas bla ma de lta bu de srog gi bzung bar bya/ ci gsung gi bka' la nyan/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad phul zhing gsol ba sing sing btab na ci zhig ltar la bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs nas/ rang sems skye 'gag thams cad dang bral ba ngos bzung thams cad dang bral ba chos sku 'ba' zhig tu rtogs nas 'ong*/ rang gi sems 'di ma rtogs na/ mthu dang nus pa rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa yod pas phan pa lta bu min/ de rnam rtog gi 'phreng ba 'ba' zhig yin/ sangs rgyas pa la nus pa la sogs pa des mi phan/ tshig dang tha snyad la sogs mkhas pa tshod kyi'ang phan pa lta bu min/ 'o na ji lta bu zhig dgos zhe na/ rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags shing rkyen bla ma dam pa la mos gus byed dgos/ lar rang la rang brdzun mi byed par blo chos la 'gro ba zhig dgos/ rang gis rang bslus na gdung sems che ba'i pha mas kyang mi phan/

yid la brtse ba'i mdza' grogs kyis kyang mi phan/ rdzas dang ka cas kyang mi phan/ rang gi go ma bcad na thugs rje che ba'i bla mas kyang mi phan/ skyob par dka' ba yin pas/ skyes bu rnams dkar po'i blo gros bskyed la lus ngag gi bya ba ci dang ci byed pa thams cad la sbyor dngos mjug gsum gyis zin par gyis la 'bad pa drag po mdzad par zhu/ chos ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi phan pas/ rang gis khas blangs pa'i tshul khrims dang dam tshig la nan tan byed cing bsgom dgos/ de dgos pa gal che na/ nam yang mi sdod 'gro /cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba yin pas thugs la de bzhin bzhag par zhu/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bsags nas/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sde snod gsum rgyud sde bzhi gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa de thams cad kyang rang gi sems rtogs par byed pa'i thabs min pa gzhan tshig gcig kyang ma gsungs/ de yang ma bsgoms na sangs mi rgyas pas na bsgom dgos/ bsgom pa la bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dang mjal dgos/ yang dag pa'i bla ma des rang gi sems kyi 'dug tshul gtan la phab nas de rtogs par byed pa la sgom du med pa'i tshul gyis bsgom dgos te/ he badz+ra las/ sgom pa po med bsgom pa med/ /

lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa dang*/ sems bsgoms pas ni sangs rgyas thob/ /rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i*/ /sems can med cing sangs rgyas med/ /ces pa dang*/ sems kyis sems la bltas byas na/ /sems kyi sems nyid mthong ba ste/ /sangs rgyas log nas btsal du med/ /ces pa la sogs pas nges par byas te/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag nas bsgom du med pa'i tshul gyis bsgoms pas/ mthar gzung 'dzin thams cad dag nas/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya ba yin/ de yang sde snod rin po che gsum po de nyon mongs pa chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi gnyen por gsungs/ de yang nyon mongs pa 'dod chags spong ba'i gnyen por dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i sde snod gsungs/ phyi'i rdzas dang yo byad la chags pa spong ba'i gnyen por gser dngul la reg pa la sogs pa dang*/ chos gos rnam gsum dang bza' btung gi snod lhung bzed tsam la brten nas zas bsod snyoms byed pa dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa spong ba'i gnyen por dge slong byas nas/ dge tshul man chad la stan cig gi steng du bsdad pa yang bkag /dud 'gro mo man chad la reg pa bsrung ba la sogs pa khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum la sogs pa bsrungs pas sems rtogs par gsungs kyang*/ 'o skol ltar na de tsam gyis kyang cung mi chog /'dod chags kyi gnyen por mi sdug pa bsgoms de la zhen pa'i blo log kyang mi sdug pa la sdang ba skye dogs yod/ de tsug tu song tsa na nyon mongs nying rgyud du song bas sems kyi rtsa ba mi chod/ des na sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la bzhag ste bsgom dgos/ bsgoms pas ci zhig ltar na rang sems la sa chod pa'i dus su nyon mongs pa 'dod chags rang bzhin med par sing gis rtogs pa de lta bu 'dul ba'i sde snod du 'ong ba yin/ nyon mongs pa zhe sdang spong ba'am dag par byed pa'i gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod gsungs/

de lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi gtso bor ston pa de yang zhe sdang gi gnyen por byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgoms pas byams pa rgyud la skyes pa'i dus na zhe sdang med kyang zhe sdang skye ba'i rkyen drag po zhig byung ba'i dus su/ byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin med par rgyu zhe sdang du ram gyis 'bar te/ gnyen pos spang bya ma chun pas/ de'i gnad ka rang sems kyi rtsa ba ma chod pas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog par song ba yin/ de ltar res 'jog tu song bas mthar thug gi 'bras bu chos sku mi thob/ des na bla ma dam pa'i gdams pa rin po che la nan tan byed cing rang sems gnyug ma bsgom pa las/ gnyen po dang spang bya la sogs pa thams cad gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs pa'i dus na lhag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa zhes bya/ mdo sde'i sde snod du song ba yin/ nyon mongs pa gti mug spong ba'i gnyen por lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa gtso bor ston pa/ mngon pa'i sde snod gsungs/ de la gti mug spong ba'i gnyen por rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sgom pa dang*/ thos tshig dang tha snyad la sogs pa bsam gyis shes rab la sbyangs pas/ de dag pa'am spong bar 'dod kyang des mthar thug chos sku mi thob/ des na rang sems phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la/ bsgoms byung gi shes rab skyes pa la brten nas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa nam mkha' ltar zhig nas chos thams cad rang gi sems su rtogs/ sems spros pa mtha' dag dang bral bar rtogs shing mngon du gyur tsa na shes rab kyis rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ zhes pas/ bsgoms pa'i shes rab kyi ma rig pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'jigs par byed cing bdag 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod pa de'i tshe na mngon pa'i sde snod du 'ong ba yin/ de ltar sde snod rin po che gsum po de/ /nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen por gsungs/ /zhes pas nyon mongs pa'i rtsa ba chod pa zhig dgos/

de thams cad kyang hril gyis bsdus na rang gi sems su 'dus/ gzhan yang bden pa bzhi byas kyang rang gi sems las logs na med/ 'khrul na rgyu dang 'bras bu la/ /bden pa bzhi ru thub pas gsungs/ /zhes pas/ sems la rig pa'i dbang gis chags sdang rmongs gsum du gyur nas des las bsags pa de rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa/ de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig nyams su myong ba de sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yin/ de lta bu de la 'khor ba rgyu 'bras zhes bya/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi phung po chen po 'ba' zhig tu go nas/ yang dag pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa la brten nas bla ma dam pa des bdud rtsi lta bu'i gdams ngag phyin ci ma log pa bstan pas de la gus pa'i tshul gyis nyams su blangs pa de lam gyi bden pa yin/ lam gyi bden pa de mthar phyin pa las 'bras bu 'gog pa'i bden pa mngon du gyur pa'i tshe na/ mya ngan las 'das pa rgyu 'bras su 'ong ba yin/ bden pa gnyis zer yang rang gi sems yin bden pa gnyis logs na med/ rang gi sems 'khrul ba'i dbang du gyur na bzang rtog mthong lam thob pa man chad la mnyam par bzhag pa'i dus su spros pa dang bral yang rjes kyi rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du snang ba'i rtogs pa yod dang*/ ngan so so skye bo rnams dngos po dang mtshan ma 'ba' zhig tu 'dzin cing rtog/ mchan rtog gi gzung 'dzin rnam pa sna tshogs su shar ba'i dus na kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin/ gzung ba'i yul dang 'dzin pa'i sems la sogs pa gnyis gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad sems chos dbyings kyi ngang du dag nas spang bya dang gnyen po thams cad sgrog rang brdal ba'i dus na snang ba med pa'i shes rab kyang der 'char/ zag pa zad pa'i mngon par shes pa yang de'i dus su 'ong ba yin/ de tsa na chos sku mngon du gyur nas 'bad rtsol med pa'i 'phrin las kyis/ gdul bya'i don thogs pa med par 'byung ba de/

don dam pa'i bden pa yin te/ de ltar bden pa gnyis kyang rang gi sems yin/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis kyang rang gi sems yin te/ logs na yod pa lta bu min/ de sems thog tu rtsis na ma rig pa nas/ rga shi'i bar du rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs su byung ba dang*/ lugs las ldog pa ni rga shi 'gag pas skye ba 'gag /de bzhin du rim pa ltar song bas mtha' ma 'du byed 'gags pas/ ma rig pa 'gags pa la sogs pa de dag thams cad kyang rang gi sems yin/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang*/ rang gi sems yin pa ma gtogs pa'i logs shig na yod pa lta bu min/ des na sems rtogs pa de bla ma la rag las pa yin pas bla ma dam pas ji skad bstan pa bzhin du 'bad rtsol drag pos nyams su len cing mos pa dang gus pa mchog tu gyur pa byed pa gal che/ de skad du yang*/ yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs kyang*/ /bla ma med na srid thar min/ /skya ba 'dzin pa med par ni/ /gru yis pha rol sgrol mi nus/ /zhes pas/ 'dzin med lam gyi yon tan thams cad rgyud la rdzogs pa yin yang*/ bla ma med na/ zhes pas/ yang dag pa'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa med par gyur na/ mchog gi go 'phang mi thob cing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i yon tan mi 'byung bas bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig gal che/ de skad du/ mgon po gang gis lung bstan pa/ /de ni ring ba'i bla ma nyid yin no/ /sems kyi de nyid nyams su myong ba ni/ /nye ba'i bla ma nyid yin no/ / dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bla na med pa'i ma zhes bya/ / zhes pa yin pas/ rang sems tshe 'di nyid la 'khri ba dang zhen pa thams cad rbad kyis bcad la/ rang gis khas slangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan byed cing*/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa dang*/ dus rgyun chad med par bla ma la mos gus byed pa zhig gal che/ bya byed mang po 'khor ba ste/ gzhan don du byed na nyes pa med/

bya ba yin pas bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa dang/ bla ma dam pa la mos gus byed pa dang*/ tshul khrims dang dam tshig srung ba la sogs pa de dag thams cad la byang chub kyi sems kyis kun nas bslangs nas/ bla nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi don du byed pa zhig shin tu gal che/ lar yang dus thams cad du rang sems gnyug ma'i ngang du 'jog cing sems can la byams pa dang snying rje sgom pa dang ma bral ba zhig dgos/ gnyug ma bsgoms na rtsa ba chod/ byams dang snying rjes brgyan na gzhan don 'byung*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bla ma de/ /mgo yis thod bzhin spyi bos bkur/ /gsungs pas hril gyis dril na de las med pas/ de bzhin du thugs la bzhag par zhu/ de dgos pa gar gal che/ nam yang mi sdod 'gro cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba'i dus su gal che ba yin/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ni 'bral ba'i chos can yin/ des na 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa zhig gal che gsung*/ /a+thi+-i/ ༈ /dge bshes gtsang ston gyis phyi phyag byas pa'i dus su tshogs chos su de rnams gsungs pa lags so/ /dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ //༄༅/ /gzhi chos nyid rnam par dag pa zhes kyang bya/ tha mal gyi shes pa zhes kyang bya ba de/ lam thabs sna tshogs kyis nyams su blangs pas/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa gzhi thog tu pheb pa la 'bras bu chos skur ming btags pa yin gsungs so/ /yang dag don la khas len med/ /gnyug ma'i sems la ngos bzung med/ /'dus byas kyi chos la blo gtad med/ /sgyu ma'i lus la snying po med/ /mi rtag tshe la yid brtan med/ /gsungs/ mi g.yo ba rnam pa gsum la/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi mi g.yo ba/ ting nge 'dzin nyams kyi mi g.yo ba/ rdzun po che tshig gi mi g.yo ba zhig dgos gsungs/ las ngan gyi 'phrul 'khor ya cha/ /grogs ngan gyi grib ma 'go skyen/ /tshe 'di'i bslu brid thabs mkhas/

/ chos brgyad kyi 'ja' tshon bkrag gsal/ /'tsho ba sbyor na yon bdag yin/ /dge la bskul na grogs po yin/ /yon tan bskyed na bla ma yin/ / blo chos la 'gro na bsod nams yin/ /rnyed bkur phal cher bslu brid yin/ / rang sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin/ /'khrul ba dag na chos sku yin/ /ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang la dmyal ba'i sems lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhir 'char ba la sogs pa rnams yin/ 'khrul ba'i dag snang la bskyed rim brtan pa rnams la snang ba thams cad yi dam lhar gsal/ dag pa'i 'khrul snang rang sems kyi rtsa ba chod pa snang ba rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du 'char/ dag pa'i dag snang snang ba chos skur 'char gsungs/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rang nyams dang*/ /rtsa rlung dbu ma'i bde nyams dang*/ /stong par go ba'i blo ngo gsum/ / khams gong ma gsum gyi sa bon yin/ /rin po che'i yis bka' bstsal gsungs/ / a+thi+-i/ /༈ snang ba yul gyi sna rtse dang*/ /stong pa dus kyi sna rtse dang*/ /nyams myong bde ba'i sna rtse dang*/ /de gsum khrid kyi bye brag yin/ /gong mas thabs su 'khrid pa yin/ /'og mas shes rab tu khṛd pa yin/ /de 'og zung 'jug kho na'o/ / bsags pa che chung bye brag yin/ /a+thi+-i/ /༈ tshul khrims bsrungs na grags snyan 'phel/ /byams snying rje bsgoms na gzhan don 'phel/ /'od gsal bsgoms na rtsa ba chod/ /zhen pa log na nor dang 'phrad/ /a+thi+-i/ /༈ phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pa la/ /gang dag rab 'bring gsum yod de/ / rab la sgom cig car du skye ba yin/ /'bring la thod rgal du nyams la 'phar 'jug che'o skye ba yin/ /tha ma rim gyis skye ba yin/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi tshul du skye/ /de la rtse gcig rnal 'byor ni/ /zhi gnas nyams byung na dga' ba byung na mi dga' nyams kyi cha yin te/ /res yod res med 'ong ba yin/ /spros bral dag gi rnal 'byor nyams 'byung la byung

med ni/ /sems spros dang brel bar kho thag chod/ /de yang snang ba la the tshom za/ /snang sems med du rtogs pa ni/ /du ma ro gcig rnal 'byor yin/ / ma yengs pa'i dus su rtogs pa rang gar shong bas yengs pa de gdams ngag yin/ /mnyam rjes mnyam rjes med pa'o med pa'i dus dag tu/ /bsgom du med pa'i rnal 'byaur gsungs/ /a+thi+-i/ / ༈ yid ches pa ni go ba yin/ /nyams su myong na rtogs pa yin/ /gnyis su med na rtogs ldan yin/ /gsungs so/ /a+thi+-i/ /༈ chos kha dang tshig phyir ma 'brangs par rig pa go na sangs rgyas yin/ skye med la gnas na chos sku yin/ /'gag med la spyod na longs sku yin/ /ngos bzung med pa sprul sku yin/ /sku gsum dbyer med rang sems yin/ /rin po che bas de skad gsungs/ /las dang bya ba thams cad kun/ /ma nam mkha' mnyam pa'i don du bya/ /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /bla ma snying gi dkyil du bsgom/ / bsags dang mos pa'i dge ba rnams/ /'gro drug sems can don du bsngo/ / gsungs so/ /'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba des/ /pha ma la sogs 'gro drug rnams/ /sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog / shu bhaṃ// // ༈ oṃ swa sti/ sha thabs kyis rgyal pos lus stobs 'phel/ /chang shes rab kyis rgyal mos myos su bcug /mo sha khrag can gyi dbang song na/ /bu chos dang 'bral bar the tshom med/ /'gol bu ba'i dpon khams su 'gro ba la gsungs so/ /a+thi+-i/ /༈ bshad pa paṇ+ḍi ta 'dra yang*/ /'gag dang nya ga spong byed na/ /ne tso cod pan 'don pa yin/ /tshig la rno ste don la rtul/ /gsungs so/ /a+thi+-i/ /༈ thabs rig pa'i ngang la bzhag gyur pas/ /shes rab rig pa nang nas nges/ /thams cad rig pa'i ngang du grol/ /gcig shes kun la mkhas par 'gyur/ /gsungs so/ /bka' brgyud sde bzhi dang sde snod gsum/ /sems gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ kho rang bzhin med par ma go na/

/sman ma zhu ba yang dug tu gyur/ /gsungs so/ /rang lus yi dam lha ru bsgom/ /seng ge brgyad kyi khri steng du/ /dus gsum bde gshegs rin chen bsgom/ /gang 'dod gsol ba btab gyur na/ /dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kyang*/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob par 'gyur/ /de ltar thugs la bzhag par zhu/ /gsungs so/ /las ngan gyi 'khrul 'khor ya cha/ /grogs ngan gyi dri ma 'go skyen/ /tshe 'di'i bslu brid thabs mkhas/ /chos brgyad 'ja' tshon bkrag gsal/ /gsungs so/ /thabs rig pa'i ngang la bzhag gyur pas/ /shes rab rig pa nang nas nges/ /thams cad rig pa'i ngang du grol/ /gcig shes kun la mkhas par 'gyur/ /gsungs so/ /lta ba nyams pa'i sgom chen de/ /tshe 'di la sbrang ma bzhin du chags/ /snyan grags sha ba bzhin du shor/ /gsog 'jog byi ba bzhin du byed/ /sgom pa nyams pa'i sgom chen de/ /bde stong 'tshol ba'i rtsol sgrub kyis/ /brag phug rjes kyis 'gengs par byed/ /za la dga' zhing 'dug mi tshugs/ /spyod pa nyams pa'i sgom chen de/ khas blangs rnams la rtsing chos byed/ khyim pa rnams dang gros bstun nas/ /phyi nang chags pa'i phad tsher tshud/ /gsungs so/ /sku ni rnam par snang mdzad la/ /gsung ni snang ba mtha' yas te/ /thugs rig pa cha gcig mnga' ba de/ /mi bskyod rgyal po'i ngo bo yin/ /

sku mthong ba tsam nas 'dzum gyis bsu/ /gsung thos pa tsam la mos gus bya/ / mdzad spyod ci byed thams cad la/ /sprul pa'i sku ni nges shes bskyed/ /ku re kyal ka'i ched du yang*/ /sgo gsum khyad gsod ma spangs na/ /nyams bde gsal skye ba dka' ba yin/ /dran pa chos rje rin chen gsungs/ /a+thi+-i/ shubhaṃ// // ༈ sngon gzung 'dzin mun pa 'khrig dus su/ /tshogs gnyis gsol 'debs sbrel mar btab/ /da lta 'od gsal mtha' spangs bde/ /sgom mnyam rjes dbye ba byung dus su/ /rnam smin lus la 'dag chal byas/ /da lta rtsol bral gnyug ma bde/ /sngon chos brgyad spu ris bod dus su/ /sgom gsum bsdams shing gzhan spyod bstun/ /da lta legs nyes rtogs pa zhi/ /gsungs so/ /sgyu ma lus 'di bzod bsran chung*/ /dka' thub nus pa dka' der gda'/ /yang dag don la the tshom za/ /nges shes skye ba dka' der gda'/ /nag po'i bdud 'di mgo mo rgod/ /chos mthar skyol ba dka' der gda'/ /gsungs so/ /a+thi+-i/ / shubhaṃ// // ༄༅/ /bde bar gshegs pa stag lung thang pa'i gdams ngag bzhugs so/ / chos rje rin po chai'i zhal nas/ rgyu phyag rgya chen po/ lam phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po yin gsungs/ yang na rgyu phyag rgya chen po/ lam phyag rgya chen po/ sku phyag rgya chen po/ 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po yin gsungs/ de la rje sgam po pa'i bzhed pas/ rgyu gtum mo/ lam 'od gsal mi rtog pa gsum skyes pa/ de bskyangs pas 'bras bu sku gsum 'grub pa bzhed/ chos rje rin po che rgyu thams cad la gnas pa'i sems nyid/ yang na rgyu ni tshogs bsags pa yin/ lam dmigs pa la sogs 'jog thabs gzugs med ltar bsgoms pas 'char rgyu zhig 'ong ba yin/ sku myong ba'i gnas skabs su rtogs rgyu zhig 'ong ba yin/ 'bras bu de thams cad dag pa las sku gsum 'grub pa yin gsungs/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ mchog gi thun mong rtsa ba bla ma de/

/me tog thod bzhin bkur lags na/ /nyams rtogs 'phel bas nyams la shar/ /gsungs pas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thob par byed pa la bla ma dgos/ de la thun mong gi tshan gcig rdzas dang sngags dang 'khrul 'khor gyi 'ong ba la yang bla ma dgos/ de mos gus mtho dman bag tsam gyis ma byung ba'i lo rgyus mang du 'dug na/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa ba/ 'khor bye ba tsam gyis ni bskor/ gdugs bdun bskor mi med par nam mkha' la 'khor/ ḍā ma ru bdun bdun gyi sgra dkrol mi med par nam mkha' la grags na/ chu 'o nai rañdza na la ma bying nas phar gshegs pa'i dus su/ slob dpon dza lan+dha ra bas kyang nga rang drag gam snyam tsa na/ de na mar bying ba'i lo rgyus 'dug pas/ thun mong gi dngos grub la yang bla ma dgos pas/ mchog gi dngos grub la bla ma ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis yang mi 'ongs/ de la skye bo kun dang jo bo bka' gdams pa kun gyis kyang bla ma'i mos gus 'di gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam gsungs te/ don la thun mong byed pa yin/ 'o skol gyi bka' srol 'di bla ma'i mos gus kyi lam yin na/ bla ma nā ro pa'am/ bde gshegs rin po che rnam gnyis kyis/ dka' ba spyad pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ji ltar thob nga bas khyed rang rnams zhib/ de la bla ma la yang phyi'i bla ma/ nang gi bla ma/ gsang ba'i bla ma/ de kho na nyid kyi bla ma bya ba bzhir 'ong ba yin/ phyi'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyes rnam pa byon pa de yin/ de la mos gus byas shing gdams ngag nyams su blangs pas/ rtsa ba chod pa de nang gi bla ma yin/ de ltar nyams su blangs pa de nyid nyams su myong ba zhig 'ong ba de gsang ba'i bla ma yin/ de ltar byas pas mtshan nyid gnyis med du gyur tsa na de kho na nyid kyi bla ma yin/ de ltar 'ong ba'i gnad ka yang bla ma sems yin pa'i gnad kas 'ong ba yin/ slob dpon sems kyi rgyal po yin/

/'di ni rang rig bzhi pa'i dbang*/ /'di la mchod cing bstod par 'os/ /'dis ni thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ mgon po gang gi lung bstan pa/ /ring ba'i bla ma nyid yin no/ /de nyid nyams su myong ba ni/ /nye ba'i bla ma nyid yin no/ / dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bla na med pa'i ma yin ces/ /'di kun gyis kyang lan re go thang ste/ ma bzlas tshe mi go /phyi'i bla ma la gsol ba btab pas rtsa ba chod/ rigs drug gi g.yang sa khegs/ las kyi zhags pa'i lus mi len/ rgyu 'bras rags pa'i cha zhig shes nas 'ong ba yin/ ngan song gsum la 'jigs pa med pa zhig 'ong ba yin/ lus kyang smon lam gyi lus/ ting nge 'dzin gyi lus/ 'phrin las kyi lus bya ba gsum du 'ong ba yin/ de la rtsa ba chod pa'i dus su smon lam gyi lus bram ze'am/ rgyal rigs sems can gyi don nus pa/ rang smon lam gang btab tu skye ba yin/ gsang ba'i bla ma bya ba de nyid nyams su myong ba'i dus su/ phra ba rgyu 'bras mngon du gyur/ rdo rje lus kyi 'dug tshul shes pas 'phrin las bzhi 'grub pa'am rgyu'ang de tsam nas 'ong*/ sems can gyi don chags thogs med par der 'byung ba yin/ 'di'i dus su ting nge 'dzin gyi lus rang gar 'dod kyi/ sar ting nge 'dzin gyi bsgyur khas skye ba yin/ bsams shing srid par skye ba'i dus yin/ bsams shing srid par skye ba la rtog pa med/ 'dun pas skye ba yin zer te/ rtog pa dang 'dun pa'i go ba ma shes pa yin/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas gnyis snang gi mtshan ma dag nas/ mtshan nyid gnyis su med par gyur tsa na de kho na nyid kyi bla ma zer ba yin/ de'i dus su 'phrin las kyi lus sa bcu'i dbang phyug man chod mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba yan chad gang la gang 'dul du de la der ston gyis 'char ba yin/ gang la gang 'dul zer nas sems can sdug bsngal can cig mthong ste/

sel bar byed pa'i lus shig len pa min/ so so rang rang gi snang bar 'char ba yin/ de ltar 'ong ba la'ang phyi'i bla ma la mos gus byas pas 'ong ba yin pas/ shi ma shi med par gsol ba sing sing 'debs shing sems kyi ngang nyid la 'jog par zhu zhig /chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos rtogs pa zhig gi nang khongs na/ yon tan gyi chos rnams ldog pa brtsi gsungs/ chos la sde snod gsum gsung rab kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa zhig yod kyang*/ sems bdag 'dzin rtogs pa'i thabs ma gtogs gzhan med/ de la stong pa byas pas pha bong phud pa'i stong pa'am/ nyi tshe ba'i stong pa'am/ mdun gyi sa phung gcig dang du bral gyis bshig nas med par byas pa'i stong pa lta bu zhig la mi zer/ de gang stong na bdag 'dzin gtong dgos/ bdag 'dzin stong par rtogs tsa na/ yon tan gyi chos rnams de la tshang ba'am rtogs par brtsi ba yin te/ de la skyabs su 'gro ba thun mong ba'i dbang du byas kyang*/ sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun gsum de la tshang ba yin/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang de la tshang ba yin/ de la snang ba 'di la 'gas yul du byed/ 'gas sems kyi 'od du byed/ 'gas snang ba rang du byed/ 'gas rang snang du byed kyang rtsa ba bdag 'dzin rig rig tur tur po 'di/ rna ba la lam byung sgra'i bye brag rnams byung*/ mig la lam byung gzugs kyi bye brag rnams byung*/ de'i rang bzhin skye ba med pa zhig yin/ de ltar sgo lnga'i yul du snang ba de la mtshan nyid med pa zer ba yin/ de gnyis su med pa de la ngo bo zer ba yin/ de ltar rtogs na snang ba rang yang sems ma gtogs logs na med/ yon tan mtho shos sangs rgyas pa yin te/ bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' khar/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas gang la btsal zhus pas/ sems rtogs pa na ye shes yin pas/ sangs rgyas gzhan du mi btsal ba'i 'du shes rab tu bsgom par bya'o/

/gsungs pas sems rtogs pa de rang sangs rgyas yin/ ma gi skyabs su 'gro ba thun mong ba'i yul/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog 'da' kha ye shes kyi lung des shes/ chos la rtogs pa'i chos de rang yin/ sgrub pa'i chos 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad rtogs pa de rang la thad sor thad sor brtsi ba yin/ lung gi chos nyon mongs pa spong ba'i gnyen por 'gro ba de la zer ba yin/ dge 'dun stong nyid snying rje 'dres pa yang dag pa'i dge 'dun yin pas/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum yang der tshang*/ bslab pa gsum yang nyon mongs pa dug gsum zhi ba de la brtsi ba yin/ logs na med/ sde snod gsum yang der tshang ba yin/ rgyud sde bzhi yang der tshang ba yin/ lam pha rol tu phyin pa drug kyang shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i tshogs dang tha snyad cig shes pa la mi zer/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin skye ba med par rtogs pa de yin/ shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes pas/ khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur/ / gsungs pas/ de lam gyi shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin/ de'i ngang la gnas pa de la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa zer ba yin/ brtson 'grus kyang tsab tsub mang po byed pa de la zer ba min/ rgyun chad med pa de la brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zer ba min/ gdug sems kyi rtsa ba zhi ba de bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zer ba yin/ chags sdang gi las mi bsags pa de la tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zer ba min/ phyi nang gi chags zhen med pa de la sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa zer ba min/ de ltar ngo bo gcig la ldog pa brtsi ba min/ de nas tshogs lam chos bcu gnyis/ sbyor lam chos bcu/ mthong lam chos bdun/ sgom lam chos brgyad/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yang 'dir tshang ba yin/ de la dbang bskur zer ba yang rig pa 'di rang la zer ba yin/

de min chu thigs gcig mgor blugs pas dgun yin na grang ba/ min pa cang mi mchi/ dbang gi yon tan yang rtogs pa de rang gi yon tan skye tshul la brtsi ba yin/ sems bskyed kyang sems stong par rtogs nas bskyed rgyu med pa zhig la zer ba yin/ yul dang yul can dgongs su gsol bas sems mi skye/ stong nyid snying rje 'dres na sems bskyed de yin/ de ltar yon tan gyi chos thams cad rtogs pa gsha' ma zhig yod na de la tshang ba yin/ de skye bar byed pa bla ma la rag las pas/ bla ma byas pas kyang rje btsun rin po che su thod thod la byas pas mgo 'dzin e yong min pa cang mi mchi/ dus gsum bde gshegs rin po che la gsol ba sing sing btab na rtogs rgyu zhig de ltar 'gyur ba yin de tsa na/ dran dang rig pa'i rnam pa kun/ /chos su thim na spang blang bral/ /gsungs pas/ dgag sgrub spangs thob thams cad dang bral nas/ rang don dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa de 'ong ba yin/ de gar gal che na nam 'chi ba'i dus su gal che bas de bzhin thugs la bzhag par zhu/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa zer yang sems snang bzang ngan yin gsungs/ de la snang ba la yang 'khrul ba'i 'khrul snang*/ 'khrul ba'i dag snang*/ dag pa'i 'khrul snang*/ dag pa'i dag snang bya ba zhig 'ong ba yin te/ de la 'khrul ba'i 'khrul snang rigs drug so so'i snang ba yin te/ chags sdang drag pos las bsags nas dmyal bar skyes na shal ma li'i sdong po/ me mur gyi 'obs/ lcags kyi khang sgrom 'bar ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yod kyang*/ byed mkhan med 'khrul snang yin/ byed mkhan yod na/ dmyal srung gis byas na dmyal srung rang tshig dgos/ de yas bcad pas byed na las ma bsags par der mi skye/ des na rang snang yin/ yi dwags la bskal ba mang por zas mi rnyed pa dang*/ dag byed chu yin yang khrag rnag tu mthong ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal mang po dpag tu med pa yod kyang kho rang gi 'khrul snang yin/

byol song la glen zhing gti mug pa'am/ gcig la gcig za ba dang sha btsan dong na 'dug pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal yod de/ rang snang yin/ de 'khrul ba'i 'khrul snang ngan song gsum yin/ dge bcu spyad nas lha mi thob kyang*/ lha la gnas skabs kyi bde ba gzhal yas khang la sogs pa 'khrul snang yin pas/ rin chen gzhal yas khang mdzes kyang*/ sems dge'i snang ba yin gsungs/ mi la skyid sdug dang brel phongs/ dgra ma thul gyis dogs/ gnyen ma 'khyongs kyi dogs pa la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal yod de/ nan tar na dgra ma thul gyis dogs pa dang*/ gnyen ma 'khyongs kyis dogs pa khyad ci yod/ sdug bsngal yin du 'dra/ de tsho 'khrul ba'i 'khrul snang bya ba yin/ 'khrul ba'i dag snang bya ba lha bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms pas yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba de 'khrul ba'i dag snang yin yang*/ 'o skol gyi lugs kyi gzung 'dzin yin pas/ grogs chen po yod par mi byed/ 'jig rten pa'i lha mthong na ni de la yon tan e'u yod/ sangs rgyas mthong na ni mthong lugs 'ga' dgos te/ kha mig rna ba can mtshan dpes brgyan pa mthong na ni/ pha gi na gsha' mar la bshad pas/ gang zhig nga la gzugs su mthong*/ /gang zhig nga la sgrar shes pa/ /log pa'i lam la zhugs pa des/ /skye bo de yis nga mi mthong*/ /zhes pas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang 'phrin las de rnams gsha' mar mthong ba min te/ dge bshes 'ga' zhig na re/ mi g.yo ba zhal mthong*/ che ge mos sgrol ma zhal mthong zer te/ grogs chen po med/ gzung 'dzin yin/ 'on kyang 'khrul ba'i dag snang yin/ dag pa'i 'khrul snang bya ba snang ba/ sgyu ma rmi lam lta bur snang ba la zer ba yin/ de la gsang sngags pas rmi lam 'dzin pa sbyang ba sgyu mar slob pa la sogs pa de yang sgyu lus gsum du 'ong ba yin/ da lta 'o skol pha ma'i khu khrag las grub pa'i rgyu gzhan gyi phung po ni sdul bsngal sna tshogs nyams su myong ba ni rnam smin gyi lus yin/

rmi lam gyi gnas skabs su nyin par gyi mi chos dang lha chos gang goms che ba dang*/ mig mangs sam chos nyan bshad dam/ bsgoms pa la sogs pa rmi med bag chags kyi sgyu lus/ bar do'i gnas skabs su yid kyi lus thams cad du thogs pa med par 'gro ba zhig yod pa de bar do'i sgyu lus/ de gsum sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad dang bsre zhing nyams su blangs pas/ thams cad sgyu mar 'char ba zhig 'ong yang*/ da lan de bas kyang rtsa ba chod pas/ rang bzhin skye ba med pa la mtshan nyid snang ba sgyu ma tsam snang ba zhig yod na/ de ltar ma gtogs pa rnams la chos thams cad 'di lta bu yin pa la de ltar ma go ba rnams snying re rje snyam nas chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje gsha' ma der 'ong ba yin/ de sangs rgyas kyi sku la bltos na 'khrul snang yin/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po la snang ba sgyu ma tsam zhig yod zer yang sgyu ma bas phra ma thub pa yin/ don 'khrul ba phra ba'i phra ba bag tsam zhig de 'khrul snang yin/ dag pa'i dag snang bya ba snang ba zhig yod na de la dag snang zer ba yin/ gnyis snang gi mtshan ma zhi nas gnyis med ye shes kyi 'khor lor gyur pa yin te/ sangs rgyas nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /dam chos nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /dge 'dun nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /ces pa dang*/ snang med gnas pa'i sbyor ba de ni theg pa chen po mthong gsungs pas/ don snang ba med pa la zer ba yin/ 'o na stong pa gcig pu de yin nam zer na/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'i chos sku la/ /

'ja' gnyis su med pa'i gzugs skur shar/ /de yongs su dag pa'i rgyu 'bras kyis/ /'khor ba'i mu mtha' sel bar byed/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras de/ / rang bzhin med kyang mi 'khrul bar/ /chos rje thub pa'i rgyas pos gsungs/ /sku gnyis su med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsungs pas snang med du gnas pa de la gdul byas snang ba la snang ba sna tshogs su 'char ba yin pas de lta bu de skye bar byed pa la sems can gyi don du mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs shing*/ sems kyi ngang nyid la 'jog pa ma gtogs pa gzhan gang gis kyang mi 'ongs pas/ dus gsum bde gshegs rin po ches dbu mdzad bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kho bo'i mgo thog na sems shing gsol ba sing sing thob cing sems kyi ngang la zhog dang*/ gnyis snang gi mtshan ma thams cad dag nas gnyis med ye shes kyi 'khor lor 'gyur nas 'ong ba yin/ de gar gal che na 'chi ba'i dus su dgos pas de ltar zhu gsungs/ chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam 'khrul ba sel ba/ 'khrul ba ye shes su 'char ba zhig dgos gsungs/ de la chos chos su 'gro ba la rnam pa gnyis te/ rnam par dkar ba'i chos dang*/ rnam par nag pa'i chos gnyis/ rnam par nag pa'i chos la nyon mongs pa dug gsum la sogs pa ngan song gsum la sogs par sdug bsngal sna tshogs myong ste/ de yang chos su 'gro dgos/ rnam par dkar ba'i chos la dkar po'i chos bcu la sogs pa spyad pas lha mi'i go 'phang thob ste/ de yang chos su 'gro dgos/ chos dang chos su 'gro ba gnyis/ chos la lung gi chos dang*/ rtogs pa'i chos/ sgrub pa'i chos/ de la lung gi chos ni/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sogs pa phyi yi ge'i tshogs 'di rnams lung gi chos btags pa bya ba yin/ de gnyis gang zag gi blo la spungs nge yod pa de glegs bam mtshan nyid pa yin/ de rnams rang bzhin med par shes pa de chos chos su 'gro ba yin/

des chog gam snyam na mi chog ste/ chos lam du 'gro dgos/ lam byas pas kyang rang nyid gcig pu zhi bde'i bsam pa byung na nyan thos kyi lam du 'gro bas/ theg pa chen po'i lam du 'gro dgos te de yang mi shes dogs yod pas/ sems can gang mthong ba thams cad dang rang gi sems rgyud gcig tu go bas sems can yang med/ srog yang med/ rnam par smin pa yang med/ snying rje bya sa yang med/ snying rje sgom mkhan yang med/ las rgyu 'bras yang med snyam pa 'ong dgos yod pas/ gol sa de gcod par byed pa la/ sems can gang mthong ba bya bye'u la sogs pa thams cad la ma'i 'du shes bskyed cing mnyam bzhag de nyid kyi ngang la ci byed sems can gyi don la byed pa de chos lam du 'gro ba yin/ lam 'khrul ba bya ba ni gzung 'dzin yin/ de'ang thams cad la ltos 'jog yin pas/ gong ma la bltos te 'og ma 'khrul ba yin pas/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' man chad la thad so thad so nas 'khrul ba yod pas/ de sel ba la dbang po sgo lnga'i yul du gyur pa'i snang grags kyi dngos po 'di rnams dang*/ da ci rang la yod pa de gnyis zung 'jug tu 'gro na lam 'khrul ba sel ba yin/ 'khrul ba ye shes su 'char ba la/ mnyam bzhag de nyid kyi ngang nas gnas kyang mig har gyis phye ba'i dus su snang tsam du 'dug kyang*/ snang tsam gyi cha ma 'gags pa de nyid gnyis med ye shes kyi 'khor lor 'char ba la 'khrul ba ye shes su 'char ba bya ba yin gsungs/ de rnams rgyud la skye bar byed pa la tshogs bsags shing bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed cing gsol ba sing sing btab na 'ong ba yin/ las dang po pa'i dus su sangs rgyas ci la zer mi shes kyang*/ sangs rgyas yin snyam du bzang por bsam zhing mos gus bya/ de la sangs rgyas la'ang sku lnga'am sku bzhi'am sku gsum mam/ sku gnyis la sogs pa 'dod/ gcig dka' las ci byed tsam mi dgos par bsgoms na 'o skol gyis thams cad 'grub ste/

bsgoms pa 'di re sla zhig yin te/ sla drags pas ma byung ba yin/ tshe 'di'i bya byed dka' las rnams che yang goms pas nus/ de 'o cag khams gzhi byung zer nas 'chi dgos nas hūṃ phaṭa mang po bgrang ste 'chi ba mdze ma byung yang 'chi/ ma shi nas bsdad pa gcig kyang med/ de bas thams cad lings kyis skyur nas bsgoms na nyon mongs pa dug gsum zhi ba'i dus su phyi'i gdon gsum gyi gnod pa zhi nas 'ong*/ nad rlung mkhris bad kan gsum zhi bas zug rngu dang sdug bsngal mi 'byung*/ ting nge 'dzin bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum shar nas lus sems bde phril gyis 'gro / de la brtson 'grus byas shing bsgoms na ting nge 'dzin gong ma yang je 'char je 'char la 'ong*/ nad pa'i gtor ma la sogs pa byas na byin rlabs kyang en re 'ong*/ 'phral cig rmi lam dang mngon shes kyang en re 'ong*/ yon bdag la sogs pas kyang je brtsi la 'gro ba'i dus su grong chog dang g.yeng bas ma khyer ba dben pa'i gnas su seng gis bsgrubs nas/ gzhan gyis mthong ba'i thos pa tsam gyis nad zhi ba la sogs pa'i byin rlabs kyang 'ong*/ rang yang byams pa dang snying rje che/ yon tan gong ma yang rgyud la je 'char la 'ong*/ mngon par shes pa yang rgya je che la 'gro /'gro ba gzhan gyis kyang mas bu gcig pa mthong ba bzhin du byas nas rdzas dang yo byad thams cad char bzhin du phab nas 'ong ba yin/ de'i dus su a po rang drag par 'dug /bla ma slob dpon gong ma rnams la yang nga'i 'di tsam e'u yod snyam nas nga rgyal 'ong dogs yod pas/ de'i dus su nan tar na nga'i mngon shes dang nus pa tsam la ci yod/ lha tshangs pa la mngon shes dang nus pa de tsam yod kyang ma phan nas yang yang ltung bar bshad pa la/ nga'i nus pa 'di tsam gyis nga rgyal yon tan bag tsam 'di rang yang bla ma'i bka' drin yin snyam pa byas nas bla ma la mos gus sngar bas kyang cher byas shing bsgoms pas dag bya thams cad dag nas yon tan ma lus pa rgyud la 'char nas/

rang don dang gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa des grub nas 'ong ba yin pas 'bungs nas sgoms/ ngas khyed rnams bskul ba 'di yang stag lung 'chor dogs nas bsrung re ba min/ bsrung ba dang de 'dra byas na nga rang gi yul na byas pas chog ste/ khyed rnams chos e byed snyam pa yin pas yo ga 'bungs/ thes pha gi nas kyang je mang la ma btang*/ gnyis gnyis gsum gsum tshogs shing pho gang dpa' mo gang mdzangs bza' gang che ba'i kha shoms ma byed/ gar log dang 'khrug pa'i sems khral mi dgos/ gar log gi gnyer ga khyed rnams la med/ khong rang gi pha gi nas shes nas 'ong*/ 'o skol gyi gnyer ga chos la byed pa yin pas/ res phyag rgya chen po bsgoms/ res gsol ba thob/ res thabs lam bsgoms/ res so sor bstan pa'i phyag rgya chen po de nyid kyi ngang nas gsol ba btab kyang de nyid kyi ngang nas ma g.yos/ thabs lam bsgoms/ yang de nyid kyi ngang las ma g.yos par don ci byed thams cad phyag rgya chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos par byed pa yin pas/ so sor ji ltar bstan pa de nyid kyi ngang nas gsol 'debs dang thabs lam dang 'u ru ru gyis/ gnyid bro ba'i dus phyir phyung zhing phyag 'ga' re tshol/ gsol ba thob dang*/ gus pas gdams ngag dbang du bya ba bsgoms nas gzod gdams ngag 'ong ba yin/ de'i gnad kyang bsgoms pas skyon 'ong*/ de'i skyon bsal bas thabs gdams ngag tu 'ong ba yin/ de ltar med par gdams ngag zhab zhib thu ba gang pas kyang bag 'ong ba yin/ de 'ga' res gdams ngag zhus btsal yang mi rnyed par 'dug /'ga' res ma btsal yang lag lam nas 'ong nas 'dzoms nas 'dug /'tshol du bcug pa la 'ga' res ye mi rnyed par 'dug pas/ ye mi 'ongs 'dug gsungs/ 'ga' res sa na rnyed par 'dug pas don mos gus dgos/ brag phug gam gzhan kun gyis spyil po'am phag na mi sus ni mi mthong*/ nga la yang mngon shes ni med pas cang mi shes mi mthong snyam nas/

spyod pa ci thod thod ma byed par lha dang bla mas kyang khrel nas 'ong*/ ngas cang mi zer yang shes dogs kyang yod/ shes na ngo tsha nyams pa gyis la spyod lam dwangs sing nge ba gyis/ las dang po pa ni gnyis yin te/ rab nyes skyon gyis ma gos pa/ rgya la bag tsam gos kyang 'phral du bshags bsdams byed dgos/ en tsam chag nyams byung yang*/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la seng ge brgyad kyi khri steng na/ chos rje rin po che bzhugs par bsams nas bshags bsdams bya/ drag na dngos su zhu ba yin de ltar byas pas me long la dri mas bag tsam gos kyang 'phral 'phral phyis pa bzhin du dag nas 'ong ba yin pas/ de ltar nyes skyon gyis ma gos par gyis shing bsgoms la/ gzhi na 'dug pa kun gyis kyang sang yar ches tsam la zlo rgyu re yod par gyis/ 'gro ba rnams kyang bsgoms pa dang gsol ba thob/ zhi gnas kyi bsgom yin tsa na sgra grags kyang gnod de/ 'o skol de dang mi 'dra/ 'gro zhing bsgom/ za zhing bsgom/ gshed na 'dug nas skyil mo krung bca' nas bsgom dgos pa min/ spyod lam rnams bzhi chos la sogs/ /ma yengs chu bo'i rgyun bzhin spyod/ /gsungs pas 'gro ba rnams kyang 'bungs nas bsgom par zhu/ a+thi+-i// // lan gcig zhus dag/ ༄༅/ /stag lung thang pa'i tshogs chos bzhugs so/ / rje phag mo gru pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ theg pa chen po'i chos byed pa la/ sbyor ba sems bskyed pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dge ba sgyu ma ltar spyod pa dang*/ rjes byang chub tu bsngo ba 'di gal che bas khyed rang gis shes kyang kho bos bcol ba 'di la gnad ka zhig yod pas khyed thams cad kyis ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du/ bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum dus da lta nas bzung nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du dge ba la bkol/

da lta nas ma shi'i bar du dge ba la bkol/ da nas sang ding sang gi bar du dge ba la bkol snyam lan gsum gsum gsum thugs bskyed par zhu gsungs/ dam pa'i chos byed pa la dal ba dang 'byor pa mi'i lus phun sum tshogs pa thob pa dgos/ de tshul khrims rnam par dag pa las byung bas/ tshul khrims bsrung ba gal che ba ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzad pa kun nas/ rab dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa/ 'bring dge tshul rdo rje 'dzin pa/ tha ma dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rten dgos par gsungs/ de yang tshul khrims kyi rgyu skyon med pa'i skyes pa dang*/ bud med/ rkyen mkhan slob ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ ngo bo sems can la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las log pa/ mtshan nyid bsrung ba'i sems dang ldan pas gang la'ang ma gnod pa zhig 'ong*/ de rtsa na mi dge bcu rang shugs kyis spong ste/ dge tshul gyis spong ba bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'ang mi dge ba bcu spong ba yin/ dge slong gi spong ba bdun 'khor dang bcas pa'ang mi dge ba bcu spong ba yin te/ deng sang mi dge ba bcu spang snyam pa de bcas pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin/ gzhan gyi don du pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su len pa de dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims yin/ sa thob pa'i dus su rgyal po dpa' ba sbyin bzhin mgo dang yan lag la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi don du gtong ba sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims zer bar 'dug pas/ sems can la mi gnod pa gal che/ ma gnod tsa na nyin re lam du 'grogs pa kun gyis kyang skyes bu phan sems can 'grogs shes pa zhig gda' zer bar 'dug pa/ ma gnod pa'i steng du sems can bde ba dang ldan na snyam pa dang*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag dang bral na snyam pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob na snyam du yang yang goms par bsgom pa de nyid la byang chub kyi sems zer ba ma gtogs pa logs na med/

de'i steng du phan che chung 'bring gsum btags na ma pang du bu 'ong ba'i sha rul la sbrang ma 'du ba bzhin 'ong bar 'dug pa/ de ltar sems kyi don byed pa la mngon par shes pa rgya chen thob dgos/ de 'ong ba la rnam rtog rang 'gags su cha ba'i ting nge 'dzin rtsal sbyong ba gal che ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa la gnas dang mal dang grogs dang brgyags dang gdams pa dgos/ de la gnas pa dben par khang pa phyag dar dang gad dar bya/ chag chag gdab/ bla ma dang yi dam dang dkon mchog gi rten bkram/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dang tshogs bshams/ blo yul du mdun gyi nam mkha' la seng ge'i khri nyi zla pad+ma dang bcas pa'i gdan la rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro la sogs pa thugs rje'i dbang gis sku gzi brjid chen po dang ldan par bsams la/ snying thag pa nas bla ma la mos gus byed pa gal che ste/ de yang bla ma thob pa/ phyi ma byang chub grub pa dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che bla ma yin ang snyam du mos pa dang*/ gus pa rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa bya zhing*/ phyi'i mchod rdzas rim par bshams pa dang*/ nang gi mchod rdzas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa dngos sam yid kyi rig ma la brten pa'i bde stong dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa de dag thams cad snang la rang bzhin med par mchod/ byang chub kyi sems chu bo'i rgyun lta bu skye bar mdzad du gsol/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dkyil lta bu skye bar mdzad du gsol/ de kho na nyid kyi rtogs pa nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu skye bar mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu thob par mdzad du gsol/ sems can don nyi zla ltar thogs pa med pa grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi nam yang gnod pa med par phan pa bsgrub pa zhig yin te/

kun dga' bo sngon 'das pa'i dus na tshogs pa mang po gru bo cher zhugs nas/ rgya mtsho'i dbus su phyin tsa na kun chu srin gyis zin nas tshong pa'i tshogs 'chi bas 'jigs te/ sdug bsngal gyis yid mi bde/ smre sngags 'don cing yid mi bde bar gyur to/ /de nas ded dpon mkhas pa yid gzhungs pa/ dbang po rno ba/ lhar dkon mchog gsum 'dzin pa/ lha gzhan la dang ba mi byed pa zhig yod pas/ kye tshong pa rnams 'jigs shing skrag pa 'di las thar par 'dod dam/ ma thar na'ang bde 'gro mtho ris su skye bar 'dod na thams cad blo mthun par nga bzhin smros shig /ces brjod pas/ kun mthun par smra'o zhes zer ba dang*/ ded dpon gyis bla gos phrag pa la gzar te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga gru la btsugs nas kun thal mo sbyar te/ mgrin gcig tu/ sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i sems kyis sgra chen po mi 'jigs pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba can sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo zhes brjod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi sgra de chu srin gyis thos nas/ dga' ba chen po dang*/ rnam par 'tshe ba med pa'i sems thob ste des kha slar btsums so/ /der ded dpon la sogs pa bde bar 'dzam bu'i gling du thon no/ /chu srin de'ang sangs rgyas kyi sgra thos nas srog chags ma zos par ltogs te de nyid du 'chi ba'i dus byas nas mir skyes te bde ba myong ngo*/ /de nas 'phags pa'i 'dul ba la dad de khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten cing rnyed bkur byas te dgra bcom pa thob

bo/ /dud 'gros sems dang bas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan thos pa tsam la'ang de tsam du rdzu 'phrul che na mir gyur pa lta ci smos zhes gsungs so/ /mal ni bde ba stan 'bol ba 'dug par bya'o/ /grogs ni thar pa'i grogs su 'gro ba theg pa chen por mthun pa zhig gal che ste/ sngon dge slong chos smra ba spyod pa rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba sems can mchog dang tha ma shes pa sems can thams cad la snying brtse ba/ de'i 'khor thams cad kyang sbyangs pa'i yon tan can mi dmigs pa'i bzod pa can/ thabs mkhas pas sems can la phan pa can du gyur te/ grong du 'gro zhing sems can brgya stong mang po dang bar bya ste/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la bkod/ zas kyi bya ba byas shing phyir 'ong ngo*/ /de dag dang lhan cig na dge slong spyod pa'i blo gros zhes bya ba/ 'dul ba'i sde snod la byang ba/ tshul khrims la gnas pa/ dka' thub kyi mchog dang ldan pa spyod lam de nyid la sbyong zhing dmigs pa can gyi lta ba la yang dag par bskul ba/ ting nge 'dzin la gnas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ldan pa/ de'i 'khor rnams kyang tshul khrims kyi phung po rnam par dag cing yod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa 'khor dang bcas pa grong du 'gro zhing sems can brgya stong mang po dad pa la btang ba'i sems skyes te/ dge slong 'di ni tshul khrims 'chal ba 'du 'dzi la gnas pa log pa la 'god pa yin pas byang chub mi thob ste byang chub las rgyang ring ngo zhes skye bo mang po la brjod pas/ dge slong spyod pa'i blo chos de shi ba'i dus su las de'i rnam par smin pas mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal bar ltung ngo*/ /der bskal pa bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa dgur dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal nyams su myong ngo*/ /tshe rabs drug cur mi snyan pa brjod pa rnams thos so/ /tshe rabs stong phrag sum cu rtsa gnyis su rab tu byung ba las phyir babs par gyur to/

/ las kyi sgrib pa de nyid kyi lhag mas sangs rgyas 'od 'phro dri ma med pa'i gsung rab la rab tu byung nas mgo'i thod la me 'bar ba ltar rnam par dpyad kyang mthun pa'i bzod pa ma thob ste/ tshe rabs brgya stong mang por dbang po rtul por gyur to/ /rigs kyi bu de'i dus kyi dge slong chos smra la spyod pa dag pa zhes bya ba de ni de bzhin gshegs mi 'khrugs pa yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus kyi dge slong spyod pa'i blo graus zhes bya ba de ni nga nyid yin te/ nga yang de lta bu'i thabs phra mo de la ma dad pas/ las kyi sgrib pa mngon par 'du byed de sems can dmyal bar ltung ngo*/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar phra ba'i las kyi sgrib pas rnam smin chen po thob ste/ las kyi sgrib pa de lta bu mi 'dod pas gzhan gyi spyod pa la khro bar mi bya'o/ /de'i spyod pa la yid ches par bya'o/ /'di snyam du pha rol kyi sems can ni bdag gis mi shes/ sems kyi spyod pa ni shes par dka' snyam du bsam mo/ / don gyi dbang 'di gzigs nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'di skad du chos ston to/ / gang zag gis gang zag gi tshod bzung bar mi bya'o/ /gang zag gis gang zag gi tshod bzung na rma 'byung ngo*/ /nga'am 'dra ba gzhan gyis gang zag gi tshad bzung ngo*/ /bdag bsrung bar 'dod pa des gzhan gang gi'ang spyod pa brtag par mi bya stai/ gzhan la 'di ni 'di 'dra'o zhes dpya bar mi bya'o/ /nyin mtshan du sangs rgyas kyi chos la brtson par bya'o/ /chos sgom pa'i yid kyis bsam pa thag pa nas yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de ni gzhan la dpya pa la brtson par mi gnas so zhes gsungs/ jo bo skyid shod du zhabs kyi mthe bong bsnyung ba la ci byas kyang ma phan pa la/ de na ser gzugs ci bde bar byed pa zhig yod pa shes la phan pa'i thabs shig yod do zer bas/ nye gnas kyis jo bo la 'di skad zer zhus pas/

de 'dra bas cang mi phan gsungs nas zhag 'gar ston du ma bzhed/ der yang yang zhus pas nang zhig 'o na ston cig gsungs nas bstan pas/ smras pa/ tad+ya thā/ gā te gā te/ pa ra ga te/ pa ra saṃ ga te bo dhi ye swā hā/ zhe btab pas jo bo'i zhabs bde/ der jo bo'i zhal nas/ ji ltar phyi rol spyod pa yis/ /yon tan mtshon par mi nus pas/ /sems can kun la sangs rgyas su/ /mthong na rang snang dag pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te de rje dam pa lags par gda' gsungs/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i 'gros ni lnga stai/ phyugs kyi shing rtas 'gro ba dang*/ glang po che'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang*/ nyi ma dang zla bas 'gro ba dang*/ nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba lta bu ste/ de la byang chub sems dpa' gnyis ni bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las phyir ldog pa yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' gsum ni bla na med pa'i byang chub sems par nges te bla na med pa'i ye shes kyi lam las phyir mi ldog pa yin no/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' phyugs kyi shing rtas 'gro ba ni dper na skyes bu gang la la zhig sangs rgyas kyi zhing lnga brgya'i phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten khams 'das par 'dod pa 'di snyam ste/ bdag gi gzhon pa 'di lta bu zhig gis 'jig rten gyi khams 'da' bar bya'o snyam ste mi des phyugs kyi shing rta la bzhon nas der zhugs te yun ring por dpag tshad brgyar phyin pa las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen pos de nas bzlog nas dpag tshad lnga bcur phyir ded nas de ci snyam du sems/ mi des bskal pa gcig gam/ brgya stong ngam/ bye ba phrag 'bum mam/ bskal pa grangs med brjod du med pa yang brjod du med pas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams de dag 'da' bar byed na/ 'jig rten gyi khams gcig kyang 'da' bar nus sam/ gsol ba de ni gnas ma mchis so/

/'jam dpal de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig bla na med pa'i byang chub sems bskyed la theg pa chen po mi 'dzin mi klog par nyan thos kyi theg pa ba rnams dang lhan cig gnas te/ bsten pa la sogs pa byed cing de'i theg pa klog pa dang*/ kha ton byed la gzhan yang byed du 'jug na de ni nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dbang po rtul por byed cing nyams par byed do/ /'jam dpal glang po che'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba ni/ mi la la zhig 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nyid 'da' bar bdag gi bzhon pa 'di lta bu bzhon nas/ lam der zhugs te lo brgyas dpag tshad nyis stong du song ba las/ yang rlung gi dkyil 'khor de nas bzlog na/ mi des bskal pa gcig gam/ brgya'am/ stong ngam/ bye ba phrag 'bum mam/ bskal pa grangs med pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'da' bar byed na 'jig rten gyi khams gcig kyang 'da' bar nus sam/ gsol ba de mi gnas ma mchis so/ /'jam dpal de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ theg pa chen po mi 'dzin/ mi klog par/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ba rnams dang lhan cig gnas te bsten pa la sogs pa byed cing de'i theg pa klog pa dang*/ kha ton byed la/ gzhan yang byed du 'jug na de nyan thos kyi theg pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dbang po rtul por byed cing nyams par byed do/ /nyi ma dang zla bas 'gro ba lta bu ni/ 'jam dpal mi la la zhig nyi ma dang zla bas 'gro bas 'jig rten gyi khams de 'da' bar nus sam/ rngo thogs lags so/ /de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ba rnams dang lhan cig tu mi gnas/ mi brten/

'dris par mi byed/ nyan thos kyi theg pa tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang mi klog /klog tu 'jug pa la sogs pa mi byed par/ theg pa chen po kho na klog pa dang*/ kha ton byed la gzhan yang byed du 'jug na theg pa chen po 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa/ dbang po rnon por byed cing mi nyams par byed de/ dper na mkha' lding lang tsho dang*/ mthu dang*/ stobs thogs ni ri rab kyi rtse mo nas ri rab kyi rtse mor 'gro'o/ /de bzhin du nyi ma dang zla bas 'gro'i byang chub sems dpa'i khrims dang*/ thos pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa'i lang tsho dang*/ mthu dang stobs chen po thob pa ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su ston par byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul lta bus 'gro ba ni/ 'jam dpal mi la la zhig nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul lta bus 'gro bas 'jig rten gyi khams de 'da' bar nus sam/ rngo thogs lags so/ de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ba rnams dang lhan cig tu mi gnas/ mi brten/ 'dris par mi byed/ nyan thos kyi theg pa tshigs su bcad pa gcig kyang klog pa dang*/ klog tu 'jug pa la sogs pa mi byed par/ theg pa chen po kho na klog pa dang*/ kha ton dang*/ bya ba byed pa la srog gi phyir yang theg pa chen po mi spong bar byams pa dang*/ rnying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms la slob la/ gzhan yang slob na theg pa chen po 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba ni/ 'jam dpal mi la la zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul lta bus 'gro bas/ bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'da' ba bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba gdab snyam pas gsol ba gdab ste/

bcom ldan 'das bdag sangs rgyas kyi zhing lnga brgya'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'da' snyam du bsam/ de myur du 'da' bar spyod dam/ spyod lags so/ /de bzhin du rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed la nyan thos kyi theg pa ba rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba'am gtsug lag khang du lhan cig tu mi gnas/ mi brten/ bsnyen bkur mi byed/ nyan thos kyi theg pa tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam yang klog pa dang*/ klog tu 'jug pa la sogs pa mi byed par theg pa chen po kho na'i bya ba dang*/ byed pa dang*/ klog pa la sogs pa byed cing gzhan yang de la 'god/ byams pa la sogs pa chud zos pa'i sems can gyi khams la lta bar byed/ ngan 'gror skyes pa'i sems can gyi skyabs dang*/ mgon dang*/ dpung gnyen du gyur te/ dper na bya'i rgyal po nam mkha' lding lang tsho dang mthu dang stobs thob pa ni ri'i rtse mo nas ri'i rtse mor 'gro'o/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba'i lang tsho dang mthu dang stobs chen po thob pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du skye'o zhes gsungs so/ /rgyags ni lo gcig gi dgos pa tshegs su 'jug pa'o/ /gdams pa ni/ gtum mo ting nge 'dzin skye ste/ gtum mo spyir ma rgyud nas bshad/ de'i nang nas kyang bde mchog dang dgyes rdor nas ston/ de'ang rtsa dang rlung dang thig le ste/ sems can thams cad lhan cig skyes par gnas/ de la thig le bde ba'i char gnas/ rtsa gsal ba'i char gnas/ rlung gi mi rtog pa'i char gnas/ de bla ma'i gdams ngag gis bsgom shes par byas nas/ lte ba na khrag a thung lta bu zhig yod pa de drod kyi char gnas/ de'ang rlung gis bde ba dang*/ gsal ba drod la sogs pa kun gyi grogs byed de/ na ga ra dzu na'i zhal nas/

rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed/ /ces gsungs so/ /rlung las su rung tsa na sems la dbang thob/ sems la dbang thob pas/ dgos pa las mtha' dag la dbang thob pas rlung 'jal rlung bzung*/ thig le a wa dhū tīr dbab/ de dbang po sgo dgu'i rtsa mig tu gram nas lus mnyen zhing drod snyoms/ rtsa mig gi rnag dang chu ser thon nas khol bur na ba dang*/ tsha ba mi 'ongs/ phung po bde/ khams dwangs/ skye mched gsal/ mngon par shes pa 'char ro/ /dngos gzhi dge ba sgyu ma lta bur spyod pa ni/ chos byed pa min pa gzhan ci byed kyang*/ ngal ba don med yin pas chos gsha' mar byed dgos/ chos snying thag pa nas byed pa 'di tshe gcig gi bskal pa gcig gi bsod nams min/ skye ba 'di nas skye ba thams cad dam/ nam zhag gtan gyi so nam yin pas/ de da res la rag lus par 'dug ste/ rang gi chos nyams su blangs nas snang ba bzang po 'phral la 'char nas 'ong*/ da lta'i rnam rtog byed pa legs nyes bag tsam re la brten nas 'gro ba rigs drug gi snang ba bzang ngan so so 'di 'byung ba yin te/ de'ang da lta zhe sdang skam pa zhig skyes pa de'i rjes su 'brangs 'khon du 'dzin pa des/ dmyal bar skyes te/ lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi la sogs pa'i snang ba 'ong*/ dud 'gror skye na'ang sbrul du skye ste/ sbrul la zhe sdang 'ba' zhig la gnas pa min pa gzhan ci yang mi dran/ da lta 'dod chags skyes pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas zhen pa yi dwags su skye ste bkres pa dang skom pa la sogs pa'i snang ba 'ong*/ da lta gti mug skyes pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas de'i las bsags pas dud 'gror skye ste blun rmongs la sogs pa'i snang ba 'ong*/ de ltar ngan song gsum du skyes na chos mi dran pa zhig yin pas/ da lta mtho ris thob pa'i dus 'dir 'jig rten gyi bya ba las blo ldog nas btsun pa zhig byas la snying thag pa nas chos shig byed dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa zhig skye dgos/

de skyes na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs sems la zhugs pa yin/ de la pha ma dang*/ gnyen 'dun la sogs pa sha tsha ru res chos byed pa la btsun pa ma byas kyang chog /btsun pa las thu ba med/ de bas mi skya drag zer nas gros 'debs te/ de bdud yin pas de la mi nyan pa gal che/ spyir yang tshogs gsog byed pa dang*/ chos nyan pa dang*/ sgom pa la sogs pa dge ba'i las byed du mi 'jug par gcog pa de bdud yin/ chos thams cad mnyam nyid yin pas nyams su len nus na chos gang la nyams su blangs kyang yon tan skye/ nyams su ma blangs na chos shes pa dang*/ mkhas pa dang*/ gdams ngag che yang rgyud la mi phan/ nyams su len pa la tshe 'di'i bya ba phal po che zhig bzhag /'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs bla ma la mos gus byas/ tshogs gnyis gsog pa la 'bad/ dam tshig dang sdom pa la nan tan byas/ bsam pa stong nyid snying rje can du 'brel na/ lam gol sa med par bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob/ byang chub thob pa la yang lta ba lta bar gyur pa thams cad dang bral ba/ sgom pa sgom par gyur pa thams cad dang bral ba/ spyod pa spyod par gyur pa thams cad dang bral ba/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis rgyan pa man chad la dmyal ba yan chad gyi 'khrul snang med pa zhig yin/ lta sgom spyod gsum rnam par dag pa'i byang chub de la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad byon nas khyod kyi de min gsungs kyang phan med pa zhig yin/ grub mtha'i 'dod lugs bag re mi mthun kyang gang zag gi blo tshod dang sbyar ba yin/ sangs rgyas blo yul las 'das pa chos sku 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa spros pa dang bral ba zhig yin/ spros pa rtogs pa la zer te/ sangs rgyas la rtog pa med pa sems tsam pa yan chad mthun/ grub mtha' thams cad so so rang rang gi lta ba de mngon du gyur tsa na sangs rgyas par 'dod de/ sangs rgya ba la lta ba rtogs pa zhig dgos/

sangs rgyas dang sems can gnyis kyi rang bzhin mnyam pa la chos kyi dbyings zer ba yin/ lta ba mtho zer ba'ang phyal phyal por song nas dge sdig phan gnod med pa zhig min/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin skye 'gag gnas gsum med par rtogs nas snang ba snang yang dngos 'dzin chung du 'gro dgos/ 'dod yon la zhen pa chung du 'gro dgos/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum bye zhir 'gro dgos/ 'o skol 'dir tshogs pa rnams kyang las kyis so sor skyes kyang smon lam gyis lhan cig tu 'dzoms pa 'di tshe rabs dpag tu med pa nas 'brel ba zab mo yod pa yin pas/ gzhan gyi nyes skyon la mi brtag

/nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi dbang du mi btang*/ chos la 'ongs tsa na sdig pa mi dge ba 'jog / nyon mongs pa spong*/ chags sdang mi skye/ phyogs 'dzin mi byed/ brgya kha mi drag la gcig kha mi zhan pa zhig dgos pa yin/ sems thul zer ba'ang phyi na zug rngu dang gzi re med pa/ nang na nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog nyung ba zhig la zer bar 'dug pa rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa bka' sde snod gsum yang nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi gnyen por gsungs te/ de'ang phyi longs spyod dang*/ nang sems can la chags pa spong ba'i gnyen por 'dul ba'i sde snod gsungs/ mi sdug pa dang*/ gshe ba la zhe sdang spong ba'i gnyen por mdo sde'i sde snod gsungs/ chos thams cad med pa la yod par bzung ba gti mug gi gnyen por mngon pa'i sde snod gsungs/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa rgyud sde bzhi yang bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud nas lus lha'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyi brgyan par bskyed cing*/ phyi nas sgro 'dogs gcod pas sngags phyi pa zer ba yin te/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud lus lha rang bcas/ sems chos sku rang bcas su da lta rang nas bsgom zhing sngar nas sgro 'dogs gcod pas sngags nang pa zer ba yin te/ de thams cad kyang nyon mongs pa dang dngos por 'dzin pa'i rtog pa las ldog pa yin/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas dbu ma rab tu mi gnas pa'i lta ba rigs tshogs dang*/ spyod pa bslab pa kun nas btus pa dang*/ mdo sde kun las btus pa rnams pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu bshad pa dang*/ sngags la brten nas tshe 'dir phyag rgya chen po thob pa'i phyir rim pa lnga la spyod pa grogs dang bcas pa mdzad pa'ang*/ nyon mongs pa dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa las ldog pa yin/ slob dpon thogs med dang jo bos bslab pa gsum du bsdams pa'ang nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gsungs pa yin/

slob dpon zhi ba lhas pha rol tu phyin pa drug tu gdams pa'ang nyon mongs ci zhi dang*/ sems can la ci phan gyi ched du brtsams pa yin/ grub pa thob pa'i bla ma rnams kyis lta sgom spyod par brtsams pa'ang nyon mongs pa rang grol dang*/ rtog pa rang zhir bstan pa yin/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen kun kyang gzhi lam 'bras bur bstan pa'ang gdul bya'i nyon mongs sel ba dang*/ rgyud la chos e skye lta ba yin/ de yang gnyen po che chung gi rim pas nyon mongs pa sems can gyi rgyud la mthug /byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud la srab/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud la gtan med pas rtog pa mi mnga' ba yin/ de'ang sangs rgyas kyi stong nyid snying rje'i mthar phyin pa yin te/ de stong pas chos sku dang ma bral bas rang don grub/ snying rjes gzugs sku dang ma bral bas gzhan don grub/ byang chub sems dpa' stong nyid snying rje sbyong bas mnyam bzhag la stong pas rang don byed/ rjes sgyu ma lta bur gnas pa med par sems can la phan bde bsgrub pa la gzhan don zer ba yin/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi dril bu ri bya ba lcags su bsgyur/ lcags gser 'gyur gyi rtsis gser du bsgyur nas sems can la phan pa bya snyam pa la/ jo mo sgrol mas de lta bu'i log 'tsho la sems can ma sbyor gsungs nas bkyon skad/ lar rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don la stong pa snying rje bsgom pa las gnad che ba med/ rang sems kyang bsgoms pas thul ba yin/ dgra thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byed du 'ong ba'ang bsgoms pas 'ong ba yin/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub kyang bsgoms pas 'thob pa yin/ tshe gcig gis sangs rgya ba'ang bsgoms pas sangs rgya ba yin/ lar spyod pa chos dang mthun pa zhig byas/ rang bzang yang dman pa bzung*/ chos mkhas gdams ngag che yang grogs kyi yon tan bsgrags/ chos la gshe ba spangs tshogs 'phral la bsags pas sems nyon mongs par mi 'chor/

blo chos la 'gro /de'ang rang gi snga blo la bsams/ phyi ma blo la dpyad/ da ltar gyi spyod pa legs su ma bcos na bla ma rang gis kyang bcos pa dka' ba yin/ chos byed pa la 'jig rten gyi bya ba blos gtong dgos/ de la mi rtag pa go dgos te rang 'chi ba'i dus su nye du dang bza' mis ni mtha' ma bskor/ mal gyi mtha' ma la ni nyal/ zas kyi mtha' ma chu thigs gcig ni 'thung*/ mig ni nam mkha' la blta/ rna bas sgra ni mi thos/ sna ni zhom/ kha gdangs/ so gtsigs/ dbugs ni ring thung ring thung byed pa'i dus su chos min pa gzhan cis kyang mi stongs te/ blo sna brgya yod kyang mi phan/ dmag stong gi bdag po byed kyang mi phan/ nye 'brel khri tsho yod kyang mi phan/ bang mdzod 'bum tsho yod kyang mi phan/ gser srang bye ba yod kyang mi phan te/ tshe 'di ji ltar 'dzoms pa zhig yod kyang slar ngas bsags pa bsags snyam pa'i chags pas yi dwags su skye bas tshe 'di'i cis kyang dgos pa med pa'i blo zhig bya/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs pa'i las dang po pa la mi rtag pa bsgom pa dang*/ tshogs gsog pa gal che/ bsod nams ma bsags pa'i mi dang rang re 'grogs kyang sngon bsags kyi rgyab med pas nye ring kun sdang bar 'dug pa/ lar 'chi khar nga tshogs mi bsags chos mi byed pa/ sgom sgrub byed yul thung ba snyam pa'i 'gyod pa brang la sen mo mi 'debs pa zhig dgos pa yin/ bka' dang bstan bcos dang gdams ngag thams cad bla ma dang sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa'i brjod bya/ kha ta zhal ta btab pa yin pas sems can bde na/ skyid na legs na dgongs pa yin/ 'o skol chos byed pa ltar snang yang zang zing gi 'dod pa blo phugs su bzhag nas yul gang na bzang dang gnas gang na 'dzoms dang*/ dgon pa gang na skyid dang*/ 'dod yon lnga'i lo rgyus zer/ bzo drubs dang*/ mkhar lan dang*/ ngo bsrungs la sogs pa la dus 'das tshe zad mnyam bzhag yal bas yon tan mi skye/

tshogs bsags bya ba bla ma bzang po dang mjal/ chos zab mo nyan pa la zer ba yin/ mi byams pa dang grogs brtse ba dang bza' btung bag re'i kha na med/ da lta sdug bsngal bag tsam la bsran nas chos nyams su blangs tsa na dgos 'dod 'phral la 'ong ba yin/ chos la 'bad rtsol dang brtson 'grus bskyed pas sa bcu lam lnga'i spangs rtogs thams cad kyang rang gi rig pa 'di nyid kyi thog tu brtsi ba min pa logs na phri bsnan bya rgyu med/ de la spang bya'i sgrib pa med par shes pa'ang rig pa 'di nyid yin/ bsgrub bya'i gnyen po rang bzhin med par shes pa'ang rig pa 'di nyid yin/ grub mtha'i 'dod lugs thams cad kyang rang gi rig pa 'di nyid yin/ mkhyen pa gnyis kyang rig pa 'di nyid kyi steng du brtsi ba min pa logs na med/ tshogs lam chung ngu rgyun dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi yang sgom pa'i sems la zer ba yin/ 'bring po yang dag par spong ba bzhi yang zhe sdang la sogs pa spong ba'i sems la zer ba yin/ chen po rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi yang rkang pa ni rgyu yin la/ rdzu 'phrul ni 'bras bu yin pas sems las logs su ni med/ sbyor lam nges 'byed cha bzhi drod ni sems la yon tan skye ba'i gsal snang shar ba yin/ rtse mo ni dad pa la sogs pa gsal cha ma 'gags pa'i sems yin/ bzod pa ni chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i sems yin/ chos mchog ni bdag tu btags pa rang bzhin med par shes pa'i sems yin/ mthong lam byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yang dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag la sogs pa rig pa 'di nyid rang bzhin med pa/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar mthong ba'i sems yin/ sgom lam 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad kyang yang dag pa'i rtogs pa la sogs pa sems skye med du goms par byed pa'i sems yin/ mthar phyin pa'i lam yang spang bya'i cha thams cad zad/ gnyen po'i cha thams cad rdzogs pa'i sems yin gsungs/

bden pa gnyis kyang rang gi sems kyi steng du brtsi ste/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni 'khrul zhing sgrib pa'i sems yin te/ 'khrul ba ni ma rig pas dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sems la zer/ sgrib pa ni gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa stong pa nyid yin pa rtogs su mi ster ba'i sems la zer/ don dam gyi bden pa ni sems ngos bzung med pa/ mtha' dbus thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bur gnas pa'i sems la zer/ bden pa bzhi sems las logs na med de/ kun 'byung gi bden pa ni dngos po dang mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i sems yin/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba'i sems yin/ lam gyi bden pa ni spang blang thams cad rang bzhin med pa la goms par byed pa'i sems yin/ 'gog pa'i bden pa ni sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa 'gog pa'i sems yin no/ /mtshan nyid gsum yang sems las ma 'das te/ kun btags ni sna tshogs su 'dzin pa'i sems yin/ gzhan dbang ni snga ma la brten nas phyi ma 'byung bar byed pa'i sems yin/ yongs su grub pa ni gzung 'dzin thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i sems yin no/ /'khor ba sems yin te gzung 'dzin dang bcas nas sdug bsngal sna tshogs su spyod pa'i sems yin/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang 'das pa'i sems yin te/ gzung 'dzin dang bral nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par spyod pa'i sems yin/ sems byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems skye ba med par bsgoms na dgra thams cad gnyen du 'ong*/ gnod pa skyel bas phan 'dogs/ mthon pos 'khur/ dma' mos 'gyogs/ mnyam gnyis kyis grogs byas nas 'ong ba yin/ nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin ye shes yin par rtogs na spang blang med pa'i lta ba yin/ spyir bshad pa pos gtan tshigs chen po bzhi gzhigs nas phyi nang gi chos gtan la 'bebs te/ de dgag sgrub las ma 'das/
