sgrub pa pos gzhig mkhan rang gtan la phab pas/ phyi nang gi chos dgag sgrub med par gnyis 'dzin dang bral/ dgag sgrub yod ring la gnyis snang yod pas log pa che shos yin/ spang blang dang bdag 'dzin gtong dgos pa yin/ spang blang rang bzhin med par rtogs pa la/ phyag rgya chen po zer ba yin/ da lta'i dus su byams snying rje skad cig tsam bsgoms kyang sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i zhing du/ bskal ba stong du bsgoms pas bsod nams che bar gsungs/ lar sems rtogs pa zhig gal che/ sems kyang ngo bo la rang bzhin gyis sgrib pas ma gos pa zhig yin de ngo bo stong nyid rtogs pa ma lags pa gzhan gyis mi go /ma rtogs pa med par bsams pa'i stong pas stong nyid du mi 'gro ste/ ldog pa'i don du rtag par lta ba ri rab tsam ni sla'i/ chad par lta ba ni de ltar ma yin no/ /zhais pa dang*/ mar me 'bar ba bsad gang gis/ /shi nas cir yang byar med ltar/ /zhes pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gur las/ gal te stong pa thabs yin na/ /de tshe sangs rgyas nyid mi 'gyur/ /rgyu la 'bras bu gzhan med phyir/ /zhes pa dang*/ smig rgyu snyeg cing 'thung bar 'dod/ /chu 'thung ba la phan mi 'gyur/ / de bzhin stong nyid rnam rtog bsgom/ /lam dang 'bras bu gnyis ka spong*/ / 'bras bu 'dod la ci zhig phan/ /ji ltar nam mkha' dag gyur kyang*/ /chu 'dzin nye bar ma 'dus na/ /sa gzhi la ni char mi 'bab/ /dngos rnams dmigs su med pa las/ /dngos grub kun 'dus 'byung mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ rig pas dpyad pa'i stong nyid ni/ /don nyid don la yid ches tsam/ /de'ang log par 'gyur ba srid/ /ces gsungs/ de'ang bla mas khrid cing rang bzhin rtogs pa'i stong nyid cig dgos te/ ji ltar nang gnas byang chub sems/ /sems nyid yongs rdzogs par rigs pa/ / bde ba chen por rtag tu gsal/ /rang byung rgyu rkyen dag dang bral/ /mi gnas mtshan nyid ngo bo bral/

/yid dwangs pa dang gnyug ma dwangs/ /gnyis med ye shes rang 'char ba/ /bla ma'i zhal las rtogs pa na/ /log par gzhan du 'gyur mi srid/ /ces pa dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bgrod pa'i lam/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i yum/ /phyag rgya chen po mchog tu dge /de yis chos rnams yongs rtogs mchog /ces pa dang*/ spros med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /nyin mtshan med par skye ba med don lta/ /lus ngag yid kyis ci byas mdzad par spyod/ /bla med byang chub gzhan du 'tshol mi byed/ /ces pa dang*/ gnas lus chen po nas/ nam mkha' gar khyab chos kyis khyab/ /chos nyid gar khyab sems yin pas/ /phyi nang gnyis med sems su gnas/ /sems can ye nas mya ngan 'das/ /zhes pa dang*/ lang dkar gshegs pa nas/ chos lnga dang ni rang bzhin gsum/ /rnam par shes pa lnga nyid dang*/ /bdag med gnyis kyi nang du ni/ /theg pa chen po thams cad 'dus/ /zhes gsungs/ spyir sngags kyi sgo nas lta ba phyag rgya chen po stong pa zhig yin par blo yul du bzhag pa de dang*/ mtshan nyid pas gcig dang du bral gyi don stong stong por blo yul du bzhag pa des don mi thob/ 'on kyang rgyu 'bras la khyad gsod mi byed na de nyid thar pa'i lam yin/ ya ki srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ ma ki dmyal khams lcags bsregs kyi sa gzhi yan gyi 'khrul snang 'di sems kyi mtshan nyid yin te/ de 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras yin/ de ltar sna tshogs su snang yang de'i ngo bo rang bzhin gyi stong par shes pa de sems kyi ngo bo yin/ de yang dang po nas sa bcu'i snang ba thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu 'bras yin/ de gnyis dbyer mi dmigs par rtogs pa de 'od gsal chen po yin/ de'ang 'khrul snang 'dis ma bcings 'khrul sems kyis bcings pa yin pas/ sems rtogs na rang grol du 'gro ste/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ da lta dngos por yod pa la bsgoms pas skye med du song ba min/

da lta rang gi snang ba 'di nyid skye med yin pas sangs rgyas kyi skye med la skye med du rtogs pas sangs rgyas/ sems can gyis ma rtogs par mtshan mar bzung nas sems can du lus gsung ba la kho bo la nges shes skyes nas de yan chad spang blang gi sangs rgyas pa'i snang ba zhig yod pa la/ dus de man chad nas 'khor 'das dbye gsal med par sangs rgyas lhun grub tu go ba la/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ rang la lhun grub kyi ye shes de/ /ma bcom phyag rgya chen po yin/ /gsungs pas chos thams cad bsam brjod las 'das par rtogs gsungs/ 'on kyang rang bzhin shes pa ma lags pa mi dge ba'i rtog pa dang dge ba'i rtog pa dang*/ lung ma bstan gyi rtog pa gsum yin te/ de la dge ba'i rtog pa ni/ lam bslab pa gsum la gnas nas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pas nyon mongs pa sun 'byin/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pas nyon mongs pa mgo gnon/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pas nyon mongs pa rtsa ba nas spangs nas las mi gsog /de la lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni/ dang po skyabs 'gro thun mong pa nas bzung ste/ lha gzhan la mi bsten dge bsnyen chen po'i sdom pa dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ de'i nang nas kyang dge slong gi sdom pa so so thar pa'i mchog yin pas/ de'i bar du bcas pa khas blangs kyi sdom pa dang*/ nyes pas ma gos par mig 'bras bzhin bsrung zhing nyes brdungs byung ba bshags sdom byed dgos/ lhag pa byang sems kyi bslab pa la gnyis/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems so/ /de la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ni sbyor ba snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang ba'i sems bskyed byas/ dngos gzhi pha rol tu phyin pa drug rang bzhin med par khyer/ rjes de thams cad byang chub tu bsngo zhing mi dmigs par rgyas 'debs pa'o/ /don dam byang chub kyi sems ni yul dang yul can gyi sems thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i stong nyid du rtogs pa yin no/

/lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ni rgyu ma smin pa smin par byas nas snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin te/ phung po lnga ma bkag ma bsgrubs pa rang bzhin gyis dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga/ khams rnams dag pa byang chub sems dpa' drug

/dbang po lnga dang de'i yul lnga dag pa khro bo bcu la sogs par bsgom/ smin pa de chos thams cad skye med du khyer bas grol bar 'gyur te/ spyir gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa'i chos thams cad kyis 'thob kyang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu theg pa chen po min pas mi thob/ theg pa chen po la'ang gnyis/ mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang*/ sngags kyi theg pa'o/ /de'ang mtshan nyid kyi theg pa'i mtho shos pha rol tu phyin pa yin te/ bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bar mtshams med par bsags pas 'tshang rgya bar 'dod/ de bas kyang theg pa mtho ba sngags kyi theg pa yin te/ sngags la'ang phyi nang gnyis/ phyi pa bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud yin te/ bskyed rim dang bya ba 'ba' zhig las rdzogs rim mi ston/ sgrub thabs nas bskyed rdzogs su bstan nas 'dug pa kun dang bstun pa yin/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud spyi rgyud du 'dod pa yin/ sngags nang pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud bde mchog dang*/ dgyes rdor la sogs pa rnams yin pas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug tu bsgoms pas tshe gcig gis sangs rgya bar 'dod/ de'ang ku ku ri pa'i lung mchog bla ma nas/ /nyan thos rang rgyal mdo sde bas/ /bskal pa grangs med gsum 'bad kyang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sar mi slebs/ /zhes gsungs/ yang lung mchog bla ma nas/ kṛ ya yo ga u pa yas/ /mi tshe gsum gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sa la sbyor/ /bskyed dang rdzogs dang gnyis med ni/ / nges tshig thob pas gyur pa de/ /blo yi tha ba rab bcom nas/ /sangs rgyas lag gi blang ba yin/ /zhes gsungs/ ār+ya de ba'i zhal nas/ pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa 'dis/ /sbyin sogs las kyi sku gnyis thob/ /shes rab dmigs med bsgom pa yis/ /rtsa ba chos sku thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ spyir ye shes ni rang snang dang gzhan snang gnyis yin te/ rang snang la ye shes med de/

de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' stong gnas shing*/ /ye shes rdzu 'phrul pha rol son la gnas pa med/ /ces pa ye shes med ces so/ /gzhan la la ye shes yod de/ ye shes med na yon tan 'phel med byang chub med/ /rgya mtsho 'dra ba'i sangs rgyas chos kyang med par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ mkhas pa shes phyir byang chub sems byung na/ /ye shes kyi ni sems can yon tan chos dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs/ rjes la byang chub tu bsngo ba ni/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che gsungs/ chos rje rin po ches tshogs su tshig 'di tsho 'phral du 'byung ba shākya'i dge slong bkra shis dpal gyis yi ger bris pa 'dis sems can thams cad la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig/ // mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal gyi gsung*/zhal gdams tshogs chos kyi skor/ - PAGE 146 -- PAGE 145 -- PAGE 111 -
